trusted_basis.verification_owner: Aegis Implementation P31 package, with independent Control Review before P32
trusted_basis.test_cli_rule: Resolve the exact configured build directory and test target from CTest discovery; never treat an unmatched regex as PASS.

obligations.requirement: Freeze one-owner Document/View/Runtime composition, narrow Host ports, async capture lifetime, close order and platform execution context before production mutation.
obligations.oracle: ImplementationDesignPreflight records current Host -> Runtime -> owner flow, target owner/prepare/commit/publication/abort flow, exact affected files, and no unresolved semantic decisions; independent scope reviewer checks the record against current headers and ADRs.
obligations.acceptance: The preflight has unresolved_semantic_decisions=[], authority_conflict=false, verification_conflict=false, package_scope_conflict=false, and maps every S1-S3 obligation to an oracle.

obligations.requirement: Source loss/unregister delivers a keyed Cancel to the real Session owner and does not cancel another source sharing the same pointerId.
obligations.oracle: Counting SessionOwner adapter receives normalized Cancel for source A; source B remains live; unregister and sourceLost are both exercised; old-generation events are submitted after cancel.
obligations.acceptance: RED on the untouched baseline because RuntimeAppBinding discards sourceLost output and unregister has no cancellation delivery; GREEN has exactly one keyed Cancel, B alive, no canonical commit, and next Down starts a fresh generation.

obligations.requirement: Control snapshot/readback reports real availability, writable, busy, permission, resource, revision, receipt and confirmed values; it does not hard-code PASS.
obligations.oracle: Counting/fake owner drives unavailable, busy, locked, stale, applied and failed states through the binding; compare snapshot and receipt to owner state.
obligations.acceptance: RED on the untouched baseline because CanvasControlBinding hard-codes targetAvailable/writable/busy; GREEN mirrors owner truth and separates pending draft from confirmed Runtime values.

obligations.requirement: Only the authorized runtime/host/test/evidence paths change, and FC-01 worktree and historical controls remain untouched.
obligations.oracle: Exact diff from 201cc8841a0e6de4cd4b8a3dfc6c337820d35704, protected-path audit, git diff --check, and comparison of FC-01 worktree/status before and after.
obligations.acceptance: No product feature expansion, public ABI rewrite, package-input mutation, FC-01/PX0/G4 result mutation, or unauthorized path; clean diff check.

separate degraded-owner test in future accepted P32 package
